name: ZX_PROCESS_RESULT_DETAILS
description: This table stores details assocaited with the rule process result.

columns.name: PROCESS_RESULT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Column to store a uniquely generated identifier for the detail record associated with process results.

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of service type code such Tax Box allocation rule, etc.

columns.name: ALPHANUMERIC_VALUE
columns.description: Alphanumeric  value associated with the process result record.

columns.name: DATE_VALUE
columns.description: Date value associated with the process result record.

columns.name: NUMERIC_VALUE
columns.description: Numeric value associated with the process result record.

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates type of tax boxes such as Taxable Box, Non Recoverable Tax Box etc.

columns.name: SIGN_FLAG
columns.description: Plus or minus sign to be associated with the box numbers.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Record type code to indicate if it is user defined or seeded.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
